name: Nylah
description: An ambitious initiate who, as the city falls, comes to believe fully and gives herself to the Eternals.

timeline.summary: Nylah, once indifferent to faith, finally believes as the city is destroyed and the gods die, and welcomes the horror as her Trial.
Nylah is swarmed by the Eternals and gladly killed, crying that she now believes.
timeline.quote: Each blade sunk into her flesh with a cold kiss
